name: Yuzuki Akane
source:
The older of the sisters, she is energetic, cheerful, and mischievous. She is a headstrong, quick to take action when she thinks of it, and makes a strong effort to the protagonist. 

however, there are times when she goes too far and unexpectedly takes an unexpected turn, and the protagonist has to follow up on her actions.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/moe_hina/MEH-008/]official site[/url]]
